focus: Practical software engineering, scientific research tools, and automation across sectors
title: From Messy Reality to Rules a Computer Can Run
utility_use_case: A reliability engineer or research-software maintainer can run the utility over an application log before sharing a high-level incident summary. It gives counts of standard severity labels and matching lines while avoiding message text in the report. A scientist can use a pattern such as `timeout|retry` to inspect how often a class of event appears during a run, then compare the descriptive counts with experiment metadata. The result is an aggregate for triage, not a substitute for secure log review or a causal or significance analysis.
